key_insight: The paper shows that W4A4 diffusion quantization improves when low-rank compensation and activation-noise reduction are solved together using a deflated Hessian objective.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical post-training quantization route that cuts rank and calibration cost while preserving image and multimodal model quality.
method: Decompose each weight into a low-bit residual plus a small high-precision low-rank branch.
Eliminate the output-side low-rank factor to form a deflated Hessian that ignores errors already explained by the low-rank term.
Add an activation-noise surrogate to explicitly reduce 4-bit activation quantization error.
evidence_signal: Across five diffusion backbones, rank-4 method consistently beat rank-4 SVDQuant on PSNR and LPIPS, and it surpassed rank-32 SVDQuant on several models with up to 6.25× faster quantization; on Qwen3-8B it improved MMLU from 61.50% to 68.17%.
watch_item: The approach still depends on careful calibration and solver stability, so gains may vary with backbone choice and quantization setup.
paper_title: Deflating the Hessian: Rank-4 W4A4 Quantization for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
